tasks.prompt: You are an employee at a marketing firm and have been working closely with a client, Ms. Thompson, on a new advertising campaign for her clothing company. You have just created the initial plan for the campaign and want her feedback.
bullets: ●  Describe the main idea of the campaign.
●  Explain why you believe this idea will be effective.
●  Ask for her feedback and any suggestions for improvement.
tasks.subject: Initial Draft of Advertising Campaign

tasks.instruction:
In your response, you should do the following.
   ●  Express and support your opinion.
   ●  Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: In today's digital world, customer feedback and social media go hand in hand. Previously, businesses relied on surveys or comment cards to understand what customers thought. Now, with social media platforms, feedback is instant, public, and widespread, allowing for swift reactions from companies. However, this also means that negative opinions can impact a business faster and more deeply than ever before. With the rise of social media, how important is the role of customer feedback to businesses?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I think companies place too much importance on people who like to complain a lot on social media. Happy customers are less likely to speak out on social media, so their voices are not heard. This leads businesses to make decisions based on the opinions of a few loud people instead of the majority of their customers.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Social media opens the door to a wider range of opinions, allowing more voices to be heard. This openness means companies can no longer ignore negative feedback by focusing on a few positive survey responses. As a result, companies have a more authentic view of customer satisfaction and areas for improvement, leading to more successful business strategies.
